iteration_note: n_estimators is boosting iterations; four-class multiclass builds class-specific trees. Counts here are fitted estimators, not individual trees.

experiments.count_derivation: Per seed: 4 forward folds x 2 experts + 2 final experts + 1 augmented classifier + 2 regressors = 13; three seeds.
experiments.forward_targets: w[y] * (I[context argmax != y] - I[current argmax != y]); ordinary uses w=1
experiments.decision: Use context only when predicted signed incremental loss <0; otherwise use current.
experiments.dropout: One clean copy and one deterministic half-missing copy, sample weight0.5 each; same labels; GBDT, not DART.

experiments.count_derivation: Per seed: 4 folds x 4 subset classifiers + 4 final classifiers + 4 legal transitions x 2 regressors = 28; three seeds.
experiments.harm_target: weighted 0/1 loss before minus after acquisition; positive means favorable
experiments.entropy_target: natural-log entropy before minus after acquisition; positive means lower predictive entropy
experiments.gain_score: predicted gain * declared availability prior / channel cost
experiments.interpretation: Greedy one-step predicted utility heuristic. Regime priors supplied by simulation condition; no learned delay distribution, calibrated risk bound, or global planner.

experiments.count_derivation: 3 fitting seeds x 2 feature views x 3 training/test protocols.
experiments.decision: argmax over four declared evaluation classes
experiments.saved_estimator_limit: No serialized fitted estimators in this experiment; source/protocol/fit receipts/probabilities establish configurations and18fits.

experiments.role: supplementary T1105 score-policy transfer, a different binary task
experiments.count_derivation: One ordinary and one target-cost Ridge fit; same Casino calibration matrix. No new native classifier fit.
experiments.target: T1105 Ingress Tool Transfer vs other author techniques
experiments.regression_target: w[y]*(I[h>0.5 != y]-I[c>0.5 != y]), w[positive]=1 or4, w[negative]=1
experiments.selector_decision: context when linear Ridge score<0; tie uses current
experiments.native_classifier_family: Previously fitted class-balanced binary LogisticRegression; three reused controls per dataset.
experiments.interpretation: Two deterministic Ridge fits, not three training seeds. Perturbation seeds are repeated views. Negatives are not verified benign traffic.
